meta.title: Signer Census metrics for v1.signer (NEAR Chain Signatures)

method.ci: 95% percentile interval, cluster bootstrap within each month; census months are exact (no sampling error)

definitions.tx: transaction touching v1.signer via a FunctionCall (exact count from FastNEAR txs_count)
definitions.fulfilled: the request's tx contains a successful return_signature callback
definitions.requester: predecessor_id of the sign receipt (not the tx signer)
definitions.requests_est: exact monthly tx total x (sign receipts per tx in the sample); ESTIMATE, not an exact count

caveats: Estimates come from clusters of consecutive txs starting at seeded random block heights; start points are uniform in block height, so txs that follow a long quiet gap are slightly over-represented.
The CI captures between-cluster variability only; it does not capture that bias or dependence between adjacent months.
Requests are attributed to the month of their tx, not of callback execution.
